errors.text: In a downside we would rank behind both.
**Subordination:** We would rank behind the secured asset-based revolver and the secured 2030 notes [DEBT ¶61, 7-LIQ ¶125].
An unsecured lender is structurally behind a large secured revolver and secured notes [DEBT ¶61, 7-LIQ ¶125].
That is the wrong place to be for a retailer whose sales are shrinking.
